purpose: machine-readable record of the verified literature references used by WP-2 Design v1 (docs/WP2_E2E_CAUSAL_DESIGN_V1_2026-09-22.md) and the census/oracle rationale (docs/WP2_CENSUS_TASK_CANDIDATE_SELECTION_RATIONALE_2026-09-22.md)

fastcontext.usage_rule: recorded only for literature hygiene; do not use as positive evidence in thesis-facing related work without an explicit withdrawal note

references.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
relevance_statements: real issue/repository evaluation
evaluation separates FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS
a task is fully resolved only when F2P and P2P conditions pass
evaluation data such as test patches belongs to the evaluator, not the solution-generation prompt

references.title: FEA-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Repository-Level Code Generation for Feature Implementation
relevance_statements: repository-level incremental feature implementation
candidate tasks are collected from changes involving tests
test patch is run before and after the gold patch
paper does NOT automatically reject ImportError or AttributeError before the gold patch because new components may not exist
provides new-component signatures/docstrings as benchmark metadata; our primary protocol deliberately does NOT silently import target-derived signatures because our task contract is different

Oracle context generally beats BM25 only modestly and can be worse on simplest one-file cases, motivating direct functional evaluation rather than treating historical changed-file overlap as the final endpoint

references.title: Loc2Repair: A Framework for Evaluating the Impact of File-Level Issue Localization in Repo-Level LLM Repair
relevance_statements: isolates localization as an upstream variable under a shared repair runtime
pooled resolved rate around 44.7% without localization, 48.9/49.1% with predicted localization, 52.4% with gold localization
demonstrates both that localization matters and that even gold localization leaves substantial downstream failures
WP-2 must prove the E2E assay can discriminate scope quality, rather than interpreting no-difference automatically as equivalence

references.title: Cost-Effective Repository Exploration for Agentic Issue Localization
relevance_statements: distinguishes recoverable ranking/coverage handoffs from restrictive file gates where F1/exact-set behavior matters
restrictive gate as a concept is NOT our novelty
our question is downstream: what does the hard-vs-soft contract do to functional correctness, preservation, over-editing, and total pipeline cost

references.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
relevance_statements: a localization -> repair -> validation pipeline predates our WP-2
do not claim localize-then-bounded-repair as new by itself

references.title: From Seed to Scope: Reasoning to Identify Change Impact Sets
relevance_statements: intent-aware change impact analysis with dependency/evolutionary coupling is prior art
graph/impact-set prediction alone is not the new contribution

references.title: Does Fault Localization Beat a Fresh Attempt? A Placebo-Controlled Study of Test-Guided Code Repair
relevance_statements: includes a random-span placebo matched to the localized edit size
demonstrates why location effects should be separated from generic small-edit / second-attempt effects
supports a size-matched random-scope placebo in WP-2
